requirements.verbatim: Set up qualifying direct deposit(s) into your Checking Account of at least $1,500 within 90 calendar days
Make eligible deposits totaling $25,000 or more within 30 calendar days and maintain that balance or more for 90 calendar days

fee_waiver: no monthly fees to worry about

churn.limit_language_verbatim: Clients who have previously received any Ameriprise Bank Checking Account bonus are not eligible; same for Savings Account bonus

notes: Existing-customers-only offer (title tag) but body/terms don't explicitly restate an 'existing customer as of X date' cutoff — author notes this is unusual vs normal Ameriprise offers. Checking bonus $400 (flat, not tiered) + savings bonus tiered $350/$650/$1000 based on deposit amount = combined max $1,400. bonus_total set to $1,400 (checking $400 + top savings tier $1,000) per max achievable combined bonus; tiers[] reflects only the savings-account tiering structure since checking is a flat $400 add-on requirement, captured separately in requirements[]. Savings account also earns 3.05% APY (not part of bonus_total). Household limit: none listed. EATF and hard/soft pull for EATF specifically not stated (soft pull confirmed for account opening, but EATF fee itself listed as 'Unknown' in offer-at-a-glance and 'Unsure' in Avoiding Fees section).
